title: Rock Shuffle
source: New for the Music Lab (Claudette), Oct 25 2026; developed into a full song the same day
feel: shuffle (swung eighths, written on the triplet)

parts.name: Boogie bass
parts.description: The intro riff; the boogie line in the verses; driving octaves in the choruses; alone in the break.

parts.name: Drums
parts.description: Shuffle; open hats in the choruses; stop-time hits; fills; the ending roll and crash.

parts.name: Chord stabs
parts.description: The riff an octave up in the intro; backbeat stabs; fuller chorus hits.

parts.name: Hook
parts.description: The talky verse tune (twice, differently) and the chorus hook.

parts.name: Answers
parts.description: Punches in thirds -- and the solo in the break.

parts.name: Long notes
parts.description: Held notes under the choruses; a slow counterline in verse 2.
